question: What does the Autel EVO Max 4N do when the control link is lost, and do incident reports match?
stop_reason: claims still failing after the revision limit

intake.focus: Autel EVO Max 4N lost control/link behavior
intake.reason: Question asks what the aircraft does when control link is lost and whether incident reports align with those behaviors.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance suggests reestablishing the control link or initiating emergency/contingency procedures after loss of control link, and to discontinue flight if control inputs are not synchronized. Autel EVO Max 4N manuals describe a reconnection state with automatic return of control if reconnected within 10 seconds, otherwise the app shows a warning and the drone executes the configured Signal Loss Action, continuing to try to reconnect during auto RTH, with Signal Loss Action triggered if the link is lost for more than 10 seconds. Unverified incident reports claim loss of control shortly after takeoff, continued uncontrolled flight away from input, failed Return To Home, and the platform not being located or recovered.

claims.text: When the control link is lost, FAA guidance indicates to try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft; if not possible, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: If control inputs are not synchronized or delayed, discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
claims.quote: Discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until further inspection and testing of the control link between the ground control unit and the aircraft.
conditions: control inputs are not synchronized or delayed

claims.text: The manual states that transfer of control between certificated remote pilots may occur, and another remote pilot may take over as remote PIC by positively communicating the transfer of control.
claims.quote: Another remote pilot may take over as remote PIC by positively communicating the transfer of control.

claims.text: When the C2 link is lost, the drone enters a reconnection state and will continue to attempt to reconnect; if the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
claims.quote: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection, control will automatically return to the remote controller.
conditions: If the link is restored within 10 seconds after disconnection

claims.text: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected,” and the drone will execute the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.
claims.quote: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds, the Autel Enterprise App will display the warning message “Aircraft disconnected.”
conditions: If reconnection is not established within 10 seconds

claims.text: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
claims.quote: During the execution of automatic RTH caused by signal loss, the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.
conditions: During automatic RTH caused by signal loss

claims.text: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
claims.quote: If the C2 link between the drone and the remote controller is lost for more than 10 seconds (e.g., remote controller power-off), the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.
conditions: C2 link lost for more than 10 seconds

claims.text: Shortly after takeoff, the reporter states, "I completely lost control of the UAS".
claims.quote: I completely lost control of the UAS

claims.text: The reporter states the platform, "continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return".
claims.quote: continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return

claims.text: The reporter states, "All attempts of Return To Home features failed."
claims.quote: All attempts of Return To Home features failed

claims.text: The reporter states, "UAS Platform has not been located or recovered."
claims.quote: UAS Platform has not been located or recovered

gaps.text: Manual: 10-second reconnection and auto return; incident reports describe loss of control and uncontrolled flight.
FAA guidance advocates reestablishing control link or aborting; Autel manual emphasizes reconnection then actions.
No verified incident evidence showing whether the Signal Loss Action actually executed in real flights.
Lack of verified data on whether RTH was successful or what conditions triggered it.
Unclear if the 10-second window applies universally or varies by firmware version.
Relation between manual transfer of control (C003) and real-world incidents is not described.

decisions.new_text: The drone’s Signal Lost behavior options include Return to Home, Hover, and Land.

decisions.reason: The exact wording in the passages is not a verbatim copy of the original claim; the correct phrasing is found in the manual as “Signal Lost behavior: Available options: Return to Home, Hover, Land.”
decisions.new_text: Signal Lost behavior: Available options: Return to Home, Hover, Land.

decisions.reason: short answer over the limits after one retry

C001.rationale: The cited passage explicitly states to try reestablishing the control link and, if not possible, to start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

C002.rationale: The cited passage instructs to discontinue flight and/or avoid further flight operations until inspection and testing of the control link when control inputs are not synchronized or delayed.

C003.rationale: The cited passage states that transfer of control between remote pilots may occur and another remote pilot may take over as remote PIC by positively communicating the transfer of control.

C004.rationale: All elements of the claim are stated in the cited passage: reconnection state with continuous attempts and automatic return when the link is restored within 10 seconds.

C005.rationale: The passage states that if reconnection is not established within 10 seconds the Autel Enterprise App shows “Aircraft disconnected” and the drone executes the preset Signal Loss Action or Signal Lost behavior accordingly.

C006.rationale: The source explicitly says during automatic RTH caused by signal loss the drone will continue to attempt to reconnect.

C008.rationale: The cited text states that if the C2 link is lost for more than 10 seconds, the drone will perform the Signal Loss Action you set.

C009.rationale: The cited passage contains the exact sentence: 'Shortly after takeoff I completely lost control of the UAS.'

C010.rationale: The cited passage contains the sentence: 'Platform continued to fly away from me while input into the controls to return.'

C011.rationale: The cited passage contains the sentence: 'All attempts of Return To Home features failed.'

C012.rationale: The cited passage contains the sentence: 'UAS Platform has not been located or recovered.'
